provenance.note: Semi-automatic rifles in .223 Rem. EPP Carbine (D.25.A, Teil D, PDF p. 240) shoots the same course with 9 mm Luger long guns and may shoot station 2 at 25 m standing. Six stations at 7 to 30 m, the record holds the longest distance.
